matrix.UNVERIFIABLE: either axis undecidable on the available evidence. R59: 'not on the page I read' and 'not documented' are DIFFERENT CLAIMS. Never guess a quadrant.

EXISTS_hom.freshness: FRESH - regenerated in-process via host/introspect_runtime.py::build_table(); version, symbol_count and blake2b identical, set-diff 0 in both directions
EXISTS_hom.SCOPE_LIMIT: TWO independent scope limits, both derived from the table itself rather than asserted. (1) ROOT: it enumerates only hou, pdg, pxr. A symbol whose root it never walked (hdefereval.*, toolutils.*) is UNVERIFIABLE, never PHANTOM. (2) PARENT EXPANSION: it expands CLASS children but NOT MODULE children - hou.OpNode.cook is present while hou.undos.group, hou.text.expandString and hou.hipFile.save are all absent yet unquestionably real. Absence is therefore proof ONLY where the table contains at least one child of that parent. 259 depth-1 hou names have zero children.
EXISTS_hom.GUI_ARTIFACT: hou.ui / hou.qt / hou.audio / hou.desktop / hou.viewportVisualizers are REAL but invisible to a HEADLESS dir(). VERIFIED-RUNTIME: hasattr(hou,'ui')==False headless, hou.isUIAvailable() present and returns False. Force-marked exists=True; mirrors checks.py::_GUI_HOU_ABSENT_HEADLESS.
EXISTS_hom.SESSION_ARTIFACT: hou.session is a RUNTIME user-data namespace - attributes are assigned at runtime, so a dir() snapshot cannot prove absence. Marked UNVERIFIABLE.
EXISTS_hom.CORRECTION: The first pass claimed 'absent from the complete (truncated=false) dir() table' as proof for any depth<=2 symbol. That was FALSE on ~140 rows and it scored hou.undos.group - SYNAPSE's own constitutional undo anchor (CLAUDE.md section 1.1) - as absent, while simultaneously naming hou.text.expandString as the migration target for a DECAY_CLOCK and marking that target missing. Caught by h22-adjudicator. Fixing it collapsed VERSION_MISMATCH from 61 to 2, which is the signature of an instrument artifact rather than a real contradiction.
EXISTS_hom.DOCUMENTED_BASIS_RULE: Where the table cannot decide but the reference SHIPPED WITH THIS BUILD documents the symbol, exists resolves TRUE at tier VERIFIED-STATIC with exists_basis='documented_in_build_shipped_reference'. Article II: observed beats DOCUMENTED beats assumed - documented is a real tier, not nothing. It is never conflated with a probe.

DEPRECATED_node_types_TWO_MECHANISMS._headline: Node-type deprecation has TWO independent expressions and NEITHER is complete alone. This is the leg's central structural finding.
DEPRECATED_node_types_TWO_MECHANISMS.mechanism_1_authored: #status: deprecated (+ a :warning:Deprecated: block) hand-written in the shipped .txt. Recoverable offline.
DEPRECATED_node_types_TWO_MECHANISMS.mechanism_2_generated: materialised at doc-build time from the compiled node type's deprecationInfo(). NEVER written into the .txt, so it is UNREACHABLE from the offline corpus - it requires the live runtime or the rendered HTML.
DEPRECATED_node_types_TWO_MECHANISMS.positive_control: All four ARE present in the full live 218-LOP sweep, so the False values are real and not coverage gaps. The #status: deprecated marker IS used in this corpus (19 node pages, 2 of them LOPs), so its absence on karmarenderproperties.txt is a genuine omission, not 'nodes are never marked'.
DEPRECATED_node_types_TWO_MECHANISMS.verbatim_rendered: https://www.sidefx.com/docs/houdini22.0/nodes/lop/karmarenderproperties.html renders 'This node type is deprecated. It is scheduled to be deleted in an upcoming revision of Houdini.' + 'Use karmarendersettings instead' + '(Since version 21.0.)' while nodes/lop/karmarenderproperties.txt contains ZERO occurrences of 'deprecat'. VERIFIED-WEB 2026-07-26.
DEPRECATED_node_types_TWO_MECHANISMS.consequence: Runtime alone misses 2 of 4; the offline .txt alone misses the other 2 of 4. The RENDERED page is the union and the only COMPLETE single oracle. Any SYNAPSE deprecation gate built on ONE oracle is half-blind. This ledger takes the UNION, and checks.py::check_no_decay_clock_emission reads the ledger's unioned verdict rather than any single oracle.
DEPRECATED_node_types_TWO_MECHANISMS.hom_has_no_generated_mechanism: Enumerative, not keyword-based: every '#' directive across the whole HOM corpus is {bestbet, cppname, flow, group, helpid, index, redirect, repalces, replaces, status, subtopics_title, superclass, type, Usage}. The only status directive is #status: with values {ni:98, nd:36, deprecated:2}, all hand-authored. So the HOM index is NOT half-blind the way the node index is.

anti_vacuity: built-in POSITIVE self-control: a synthetic known-offender must be flagged, else the check fails 'detector broken'
built-in NEGATIVE self-control: a synthetic OK symbol must NOT be flagged, else the gate would fire on everything

missing or malformed emission corpus => FAIL
ledger present but with no `symbols` key => FAIL (gutted)
STALE corpus + no offenders => ok:None (undecidable), never a green all-clear. Positive evidence stays conclusive.
category-scoped names with no resolved emission category => ok:None, never a guess in either direction

for_ruling.question: Arm check_no_decay_clock_emission as a cross-cutting guardrail in tasks.json, or leave it registered-but-unarmed?
for_ruling.context: It is real and it FAILS TODAY on karma + karmarenderproperties. Arming it reds every sprint and blocks legs that have nothing to do with the defect. Leaving it unarmed means a green board while a known decay clock ships. R7 already owns the remediation in L2's slipstream.
for_ruling.recommendation: Leave unarmed until R7's migration lands, then arm in the SAME commit that cleans the corpus - so the gate's first green is earned, not inherited. Article I: this is a value judgement with a cost either way, so it is not mine.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Article I - defensible options, real cost on both sides

for_ruling.question: Who owns fixing shared/bridge.py:1718 (H5-F3), and does it block the release?
for_ruling.context: A documented safety mechanism (R8 PDG failure recovery) has never executed. The fix is one keyword: remove_files -> remove_outputs. H5 is read-only and did not touch it. It is user-invisible until a PDG cook fails, at which point recovery silently does not happen - though the status is reported honestly.
for_ruling.recommendation: One-line fix, but it needs a leg with a real oracle - a live PDG cook that fails and asserts the tasks were actually dirtied. Fixing it blind would replace a known-dead path with an unverified one.

for_ruling.question: Regenerate the emission corpus, and fix its extractor's blindness first?
for_ruling.context: H5-F4: the corpus is 174 commits stale AND literal-anchored, so it cannot see createNode(<variable>) dispatch. Regenerating it with today's extractor would DROP karmarenderproperties and turn the new gate green while the defect is untouched. The gate's staleness guard covers the symptom, not the cause.
for_ruling.recommendation: Fix the extractor to resolve bare-string constants that flow into createNode BEFORE regenerating. Order matters: regenerate-then-fix leaves a window where the gate lies.
for_ruling.why_escalated: sequencing decision with a correctness consequence

for_ruling.question: Should the decay-clock gate extend to the RAG teaching corpus?
for_ruling.context: U.6 found phantom createNode sites in rag/ outside the emission gate, re-teaching them via knowledge_lookup. This census found 10,355 teaching-context occurrences. karmaocean/karmaprocedural appear ONLY as teaching sites. A user told to build a deprecated node is a defect the emission gate cannot see. Deliberately NOT added: the brief said one check, on the emission corpus, and widening an oracle silently is exactly what Law 7 forbids.
for_ruling.recommendation: Yes, but as its own check with its own failure demonstration - not by widening this one.

for_ruling.question: Promote the H5 producer scripts from the session scratchpad into scripts/?
for_ruling.context: Law 2 requires a producer path beside every number. All five producers live in the scratchpad because the brief scoped writes to the ledger, one check, and the receipt. Their sha256 are recorded in the ledger, but a scratchpad is not durable and the ledger's numbers become unreproducible once the session is gone.
for_ruling.recommendation: Promote h5_join.py and h5_census.py at minimum. A ledger whose producer cannot be re-run is a number travelling without its producer - R31's disease, one level up.
for_ruling.why_escalated: writing outside the grant is a ruling item, not a permission problem (Article I corollary)

for_ruling.question: Accept the census's 4th symbol kind, hom_method?

for_ruling.question: Process: the orchestrator wrote harness/verify/checks.py in the same worktree the cartographer was reading, and the cartographer flagged it.

Subagents here were scratchpad-write-only and the orchestrator held the sole repo-write grant, so nothing was corrupted - but a mapping agent observed a file mid-write and correctly reported the inconsistency.
